tools.name: list_types
tools.description: List the available checks, price, network and payment details (free). Only $0.001 (0.1 cent) per check, paid via x402 in USDC on Base.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: IBAN: country length + ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum. Only $0.001 (0.1 cent) per check, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. Returns {type, valid, normalized, reason}; the input is never echoed or stored and personal identifiers are masked.

tools.name: validate_eu_vat
tools.description: EU VAT number: per-country format (offline, no VIES); PL also NIP checksum. Only $0.001 (0.1 cent) per check, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. Returns {type, valid, normalized, reason}; the input is never echoed or stored and personal identifiers are masked.

tools.name: validate_pl_nip
tools.description: Polish NIP tax id: 10 digits + weighted mod-11 checksum. Only $0.001 (0.1 cent) per check, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. Returns {type, valid, normalized, reason}; the input is never echoed or stored and personal identifiers are masked.

tools.name: validate_pl_regon
tools.description: Polish REGON: 9 or 14 digits + mod-11 checksum. Only $0.001 (0.1 cent) per check, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. Returns {type, valid, normalized, reason}; the input is never echoed or stored and personal identifiers are masked.

tools.name: validate_pl_pesel
tools.description: Polish PESEL: checksum + encoded birth date and sex. Only $0.001 (0.1 cent) per check, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. Returns {type, valid, normalized, reason}; the input is never echoed or stored and personal identifiers are masked.

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Email address syntax (dot-atom local part, LDH domain; no DNS). Only $0.001 (0.1 cent) per check, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. Returns {type, valid, normalized, reason}; the input is never echoed or stored and personal identifiers are masked.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_email · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: validate_eu_vat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_email · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: validate_eu_vat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
